mapper.update: UPDATE background_tasks SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', finished_at = #{completedAt}, heartbeat_at = #{completedAt}, failure_code = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, result_count = #{resultCount} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE background_tasks SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = #{failedAt}, heartbeat_at = #{failedAt}, failure_code = #{code}, failure_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE background_tasks SET status = 'PENDING', started_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, deadline_at = #{deadlineAt}, failure_code = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, cancel_requested_at = NULL, result_count = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId}
UPDATE background_tasks SET status = 'CANCELED', cancel_requested_at = #{canceledAt}, finished_at = #{canceledAt}, heartbeat_at = #{canceledAt} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE background_tasks SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = #{now}, heartbeat_at = #{now}, failure_code = 'BACKGROUND_TASK_TIMEOUT', failure_reason = 'Task exceeded its execution deadline' WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at < #{now}
